elements.element: Commercial general liability USD 1M per occurrence
elements.evidence: "commercial general liability insurance of not less than One Million Dollars ($1,000,000) per occurrence"
"professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000)"

elements.element: Cyber/privacy USD 5M covering processing of Customer Data
elements.evidence: "cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than Five Million Dollars ($5,000,000) covering HDI's processing of Company customer data"

elements.element: Workers' compensation as required by law
elements.evidence: "workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law"
"provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request"

elements.element: Obligation sits on Vendor (HDI, the hosting provider) and runs through the term
elements.evidence: "HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement"
"not less than Two Million Dollars ($2,000,000)" E&O exceeds the 1M floor
"not less than Five Million Dollars ($5,000,000)" cyber exceeds the 2M floor

reasons: All six preferred coverage/mechanic elements are expressly present with the correct amounts, per-occurrence/aggregate split, cyber tied to processing of Company customer data, workers' compensation, and certificates on request.
The insertion is a concise new clause responding to a wholly absent insurance obligation; no existing sentence was rewritten and no new exception or carve-out was added.

Untouched terms (headings, counterparts) remain effective; the obligation is placed on the correct counterparty (HDI as host/vendor) and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced ('Company customer data' reads descriptively).
Note only: coverage is limited to the term with no post-termination tail, which the playbook treats as a rationale note rather than a deviation.
